name: MSI MAG A1000GLS PCIE5 1000W 80 Plus Gold Fully Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.1 Power Supply
shortDescription: MSI MAG A1000GLS PCIE5 1000W Power Supply (80 Plus Gold Certified / Fully Modular Design / ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 Ready / Native 16-pin 12V-2x6 Cable / Fluid Dynamic Bearing Fan / Active PFC & Full Protection / 3 Yea
descriptionHtml:
MSI MAG A1000GLS PCIE5 1000W Power Supply (80 Plus Gold Certified / Fully Modular Design / ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 Ready / Native 16-pin 12V-2x6 Cable / Fluid Dynamic Bearing Fan / Active PFC & Full Protection / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Power your high-performance gaming rig with the MSI MAG A1000GLS PCIE5 1000W power supply, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Built to support next-generation graphics cards and heavy workloads, this unit features 80 Plus Gold efficiency and a fully modular flat cable setup for effortless cable routing. Fully compliant with ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards, it includes a native dual-color 16-pin 12V-2x6 connector designed to handle power excursions up to 200%. Equipped with a 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan, industrial-grade protections, and compact dimensions, the MAG A1000GLS guarantees continuous, stable, and whisper-quiet power delivery.
